title: Borland's congressional testimony on the Langley triangle

tellings.quote: During the summer of 2012, my team was on standby for weather and I returned to my barracks on base and at approximately 0130, I saw an approximately 100 ft equilateral triangle take off from near the NASA hanger on the base

plain: In the summer of 2012, at about 1:30 in the morning, a triangle with three equal sides, roughly 100 feet across, took off from near a NASA hangar on a military base. NASA is the US space agency. This is the account of a man named Dylan Borland, who says he saw it himself on his way back to his barracks while his team was waiting out the weather, and who put it in testimony he gave to the US Congress. If it is true, a large unknown craft was flying freely from an American base.
